get.title: Docling Technical Report
get.abstract: This technical report introduces Docling, an easy to use, self-contained, MITlicensed open-source package for PDF document conversion. It is powered by state-of-the-art specialized AI models for layout analysis (DocLayNet) and table structure recognition (TableFormer), and runs efficiently on commodity hardware in a small resource budget. The code interface allows for easy extensibility and addition of new features and models.
references: J. AI. Easyocr: Ready-to-use ocr with 80+ supported languages. https://github.com/ JaidedAI/EasyOCR, 2024. Version: 1.7.0.
